'''Explosive dampeners''' were components used in [[Cluster bomb/Legends|cluster bombs]] such as [[FreiTek Incorporated/Legends|FreiTek's]] [[CL-3 antistarfighter cluster bomb]]. The dampeners were designed to protect the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that the [[Bomb/Legends|bomb]] was mounted on during the initial stages of the weapon's detonation.<ref name="EGWT" />
